t: Re Performance By Mr. Herbert Zerbert, German Jewish Refugee

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. N 1766
REPORT
S.4-A, Crime & Special Branch Station. File No.................... Date April 12, 1943.

SUBJECT: Re performances by Mr. Herbert Zerbert
German Jewish Refugee.

Sir:

The undersigned begs to report, that the above
mentioned person, held a show in the Chaoufoong Rd
Refugee Camp, without the consent of this Office
and without obtaining the necessary license to do so.
The performance in question was staged in the p.m.
of the 8-4-43 in the aforementioned Camp and the
entrance fee's were $1,- and -,60. A ticket used
is herewith attached for reference.

Through information received, the undersigned
learned, that the performer Mr. Zernick had formed
his reciting on an anti German and Japanese nature.

During the performance Mr. Zernick ridiculed the
Japanese Gentries in their manner of searching pedes-
trians whilst in one phrase he stated that the Adolph
Hitler Square in Berlin had already been renamed the
Stalin Square and other phrases of a similiar nature.

It has further come to the notice of the under-
signed, that Mr. Zernick will hold another show in
the East Seward Rd Refugee Camp on the 13-4-43 at
about 8:30 p.m. The programme and other particulars
are the same as the one mentioned above.

The show in the East Seward Rd. Camp has also not
been registered with this Office and no application
for license was made.

The undersigned respectfully suggests, that the
Officer i/c. Wayside Station be informed and the
performance prohibited.

Officer i/c Station 4 D. S. 6F
D. C. (Crime & Special Branch)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。编号 1766
报告
S.4-A，刑事与特别分部警署。档案号.................... 日期 1943年4月12日。

事由：关于赫伯特·泽伯特（Herbert Zerbert）先生的演出
德国犹太难民。

敬启者：

卑职谨此报告，上述人员未经本处同意，亦未取得必要执照，即在兆丰路（Chaoufoong Rd）难民营举行演出。该演出于1943年4月8日下午在上述难民营举行，入场费为1元及0.60元。现随函附上一张所用门票，以供查考。

据所获情报，卑职获悉，表演者泽尼克（Zernick）先生的朗诵内容具有反德及反日性质。

在演出过程中，泽尼克先生讥讽日本绅士搜查行人的方式，并在其中一句话中声称，柏林的阿道夫·希特勒广场已更名为斯大林广场，以及其他类似性质的言论。

卑职进一步获悉，泽尼克先生将于1943年4月13日晚上8时30分左右，在东华德路（East Seward Rd）难民营举行另一场演出。节目单及其他细节与上述演出相同。

东华德路难民营的这场演出也未向本处登记，且未申请执照。

卑职谨建议，通知路边警署（Wayside Station）主管警官，并禁止该演出。

第四警署主管警官 D. S. 6F
副督察（刑事与特别分部）

（左侧竖排批注）
责任人
泽尼克（Zernick）……有安：周……为念顺……署空自背视殿（事后联系）
……每年举办。给予，有安：周……为念顺……署空自背视殿（事后联系）
关于有偿演出之事，已严正警告，须向各机构申报，以便根据征收税款情况颁发执照。

（左下角批注）
执行 b
